note: CANDIDATE hard tasks. These are not the final set: exp_build_hard.py probes each one at baseline and keeps only the ones the subject model FAILS unaided. Selecting by baseline failure (not by which skills exist) is what makes the resulting set discriminative without making it best-case. Every task needs a specific, checkable fact -- an exact flag, API signature, config key, or version-specific behaviour -- rather than a well-known practice the model can recite.

tasks.prompt: Using the uv package manager, what is the exact command to add a dependency only for the dev group, and what section does it write to in pyproject.toml?
